map_bounds.method: Floating-point Bernstein convex-hull bound for degree-(5,5) XY Jacobian on every knot cell, using one-sided derivatives at cell boundaries.
map_bounds.limitation: Numerical polynomial bounds, not interval-arithmetic proof; does not rate physical knot distribution.
